name: MailCraft Spam AI
description:
Checks new mail in MailCraft with a language model (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and moves spam from the inbox to the junk folder. Based on the spam filter of the Thunderbird add-on ThunderAI.

MailCraft must open its control channel; for the Flatpak, the Set Up button in the preferences does this once for every start.

The filter keeps running while the screen is locked (session mode unlock-dialog), so mail is sorted while you are away. Nothing is shown on the lock screen.
